_README: Curated rows of the security master (src/data_extract/utils/common/security_master.py). Every entry cites a URL or an SEC accession in `source`; an entry without one is refused at load.

conversion_ratios: dated number of canonical-class shares one share of `cusip` is worth, half-open trade dates [valid_from, valid_to) (null = open). Only contractual ratios live here; every other common class is 1.

market_boundaries: CUSIP-qualified role and issuer over half-open trade dates; they override the derived issuer and the lineage-window role for that CUSIP. role is one of canonical_predecessor, canonical_current, secondary_class, acquired_constituent, excluded (excluded rows name the reason).
class_overrides: {cusip, security_class, source} for a line whose class evidence the FTD description does not carry.
merger_metadata: the boundary-day facts the insider lineage (Q2f) reads. The financial-statement register keeps its own meaning.

reverse_acquisitions: a merger whose legal survivor (the traded security) was not the accounting acquirer. The survivor's filings with a period of report on or after seam_date restate pre-seam periods with the accounting acquirer's numbers; the fundamentals history ignores those facts (period_end before seam_date), so pre-seam periods keep the traded security's own as-filed values. The survivor's own amendments of pre-seam periods are kept.

co_registrants: subsidiary CIKs that file event forms under the parent's symbol and whose rows are not stored (decision D-Q2-1). The identity-flags rule finds the ones beside a roster window (DLR LP, PG&E utility, PPL Electric, ONEOK); the curated ones it never judges are listed here.

exchange_ratios: the merger exchange ratio of each register predecessor window whose vendor series replaces the canonical one (decision P31): one share of predecessor_cik became `ratio` shares of the ticker on seam_date. The merged fundamentals history multiplies the window owner's share counts and divides its per-share figures by ratio x the ticker's splits after the seam; only genuine share events (split_events) enter the count, a price-only factor Yahoo books as a split stays in the cube's level factor S(d). The PIT share count stays the owner's as-filed count.

vendor_series_overrides: a cited vendor series for a ticker whose own vendor series before valid_to is another company's and whose window owner has no register window (decision D2a): {ticker, vendor_ticker, cik, valid_from, valid_to, source}. The merged fundamentals history replaces the ticker's vendor rows with reportperiod in [valid_from, valid_to) by vendor_ticker's, on the share basis of the exchange_ratios entry for (ticker, cik), and the Sharadar fetch lists vendor_ticker.

conversion_ratios.evidence: Each Class A share converts into 30 Class B shares before the 50-for-1 Class B split approved on 2010-01-20 (8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000115752310000241/); FTD A/B price ratio p50 30.36 before 2010-01-21.
After the 50-for-1 Class B split effective 2010-01-21 one Class A share converts into 30 x 50 = 1,500 Class B shares; FTD A/B price ratio p50 1,500.2 from 2010-01-21.

market_boundaries.evidence: Delphi Automotive PLC traded as DLPH from its 2011-11-17 IPO (first FTD row settles 2011-11-22) until the 2017-12-04 spin-off of Delphi Technologies and the rename to Aptiv PLC (8-K Items 2.01, 5.03 filed 2017-12-07); APTV (G6095L109) from 2017-12-05. Decision P20.
New News Corp Class A began regular-way trading on 2013-07-01 after the 2013-06-28 separation (8-K Items 5.03, 8.01 filed 2013-07-03). Decision P20.
Exxon Mobil Corp common until the holding-company reorganisation (8-K Items 2.01, 3.03 of ExxonMobil Holdings Corp filed 2026-07-01); the old CUSIP's last FTD row settles 2026-07-02. Decision P20.

ExxonMobil Holdings Corp common from 2026-07-02; the XOMZZZZ placeholder at $0.01 settles that day and is excluded. The CIK window of 0002115436 starts 2026-07-01 (registrant_cutover.json). Decision P20.
Fox Corporation Class A from the 2019-03-19 separation from 21st Century Fox (8-K Items 2.01, 3.03, 5.03 filed 2019-03-19). Decision P20.

Google Class A is the canonical line throughout: traded as GOOG until 2014-04-03, as GOOGL from the 2014-04-03 Class C dividend (8-K Item 3.03 filed 2014-03-26), bounded by its own last observation, then Alphabet 02079K305. Class C 38259P706 is a secondary class. Decision P20.
Chesapeake Energy common as CHK from the first FTD row (2009-07-01) until its 2020-04 reverse split, bounded by the CUSIP's own observations. Decision P20.
Post-reverse-split Chesapeake common (CHK, then CHKAQ in bankruptcy) until the old equity was cancelled at emergence on 2021-02-09 (8-K Items 1.02, 3.03, 5.03 filed 2021-02-09).
CHKAQ fails still settling after the 2021-02-09 cancellation; they overlap the new CUSIP 165167735 for 6 settlement days and are never summed with it.
New Chesapeake common issued at the 2021-02-09 emergence (CHK, EXE from 2024-10-02).

Discovery Series A common (DISCA) ceased trading on Nasdaq after the close of the 2022-04-08 Closing Date of the WarnerMedia merger (8-K Items 2.01, 3.01, 3.03, 8.01 filed 2022-04-12); its last FTD fail settles 2022-04-12 (trade date 2022-04-08). Decision §13.2.

Warner Bros. Discovery common commenced trading on Nasdaq as WBD on 2022-04-11 (8-K Item 8.01 filed 2022-04-12); its FTD rows settling 2022-04-11/12 carry trade dates 2022-04-07/08, before WBD traded. Decision §13.2.

Fox Corporation Class B regular-way from the 2019-03-19 separation (8-K Item 2.01 filed 2019-03-19), like the FOXA line. Without this start the line ran back over FINRA's FOX days, which before 2019-03-19 are 21st Century Fox's Class B: 116 days 2018-08-01 .. 2019-01-16 (offline rebuild) and 40 stored days 2019-01-17 .. 2019-03-18 summed into FOXA.

The DOC line of this CUSIP starts at its first fail (trade date 2024-03-01), not earlier: FINRA's DOC on 2024-02-29 is Physicians Realty's last session (2.3M shares), which was summed into DOC beside the PEAK row of the same day.

Physicians Realty common (DOC) through its last session, 2024-02-29, before the 2024-03-01 merger (8-K of 0001574540 filed 2024-03-01): FINRA's DOC on 2024-02-29 is labelled acquired_constituent, never summed.

Ingersoll-Rand plc traded as IR through the 2020-02-28 session; it became Trane Technologies plc on the 2020-02-29 completion of the Industrial spin-off and merger (8-K Item 2.01 filed 2020-03-05) and IR passed to Ingersoll Rand Inc. on 2020-03-02. FINRA's IR on 2020-02-28 was excluded as superseded.
Trane Technologies plc common as TT from 2020-03-02; its FTD rows with trade date 2020-02-28 precede TT trading.

Mylan N.V. traded as MYL through the 2020-11-16 session, when trading was suspended at the Viatris closing (8-K Item 3.01 filed 2020-11-19). FINRA's MYL on 2020-11-13 and 2020-11-16 was acquired_constituent (Upjohn's register window opens 2020-11-07).
Viatris common as VTRS from 2020-11-17 (first FINRA day); its FTD rows with trade dates 2020-11-13/16 precede VTRS trading.
II-VI common traded as IIVI through the 2022-09-07 session; COHR from 2022-09-08 (8-K Item 8.01 filed 2022-09-08). FINRA's IIVI on 2022-09-06/07 was excluded as superseded.
Coherent Corp. common as COHR from 2022-09-08; its FTD rows with trade dates 2022-09-06/07 precede COHR trading.

merger_metadata.evidence: Merck / Schering-Plough reverse merger consummated on 2009-11-03 (8-K of CIK 0000310158 filed 2009-11-04); the closing after the 16:00 close is decision P25. On the boundary day a row reporting SGP is acquired_constituent; under 0000310158 code A rows are canonical_current and code D/J rows acquired_constituent; rows under 0000064978 are canonical_predecessor.

exchange_ratios.evidence: Praxair / Linde AG combination under Linde plc (CIK 0001707925): each Praxair share 'was converted into the right to receive one ordinary share ... of Linde plc'; Linde AG shares were exchanged at 1.540 (8-K Item 2.01 of CIK 0000884905 filed 2018-10-31; also 0001193125-18-313073 of CIK 0001707925). LIN's pre-seam price history is Praxair's (its 2003-12-16 2:1 split is in prices_splits).

Westar Energy / Great Plains Energy merger under Evergy (CIK 0001711269): each Westar share 'was converted into the right to receive one ... share of common stock ... of Evergy'; each Great Plains share into 0.5981 (8-K Item 8.01 of CIK 0000054507 filed 2018-06-04). EVRG's pre-seam price history is Westar's.

Baker Hughes / GE Oil & Gas: each Baker Hughes share 'will be converted into the right to receive one share of Class A common stock' of the new company plus a special dividend of $17.50 per share (8-K Item 1.01 of CIK 0000808362 filed 2016-11-01; the 2017-03-27 amendment, 0000950103-17-003027, keeps 100% of Class A with the Baker Hughes holders); consummated 2017-07-03 (8-K 0001193125-17-220950). BKR's pre-seam price history is Baker Hughes Inc's; the 2017-07-05 price drop is the $17.50 dividend, not a share-basis change.

STERIS Corp / Synergy Health combination under STERIS plc (CIK 0001624899): each STERIS US share 'was converted into the right to receive one New STERIS Share'; each Synergy share received 0.4308 New STERIS Shares and 439 pence (8-K Item 2.01 of CIK 0000815065 filed 2015-11-06; also 0001193125-15-370270 of CIK 0001624899). STE's pre-seam price history is STERIS Corp's (its 1998-08-25 2:1 split is in prices_splits).

Tyco International plc (CIK 0000833444, renamed Johnson Controls International plc) merged with Johnson Controls, Inc. on 2016-09-02 and effected a 0.955-for-one consolidation of its ordinary shares (8-K Items 2.01, 3.03 filed 2016-09-06). Ratio 1: Yahoo books the consolidation as the JCI split of 2016-09-06 and split_events rejects it (0.955 is not split-shaped, no Sharadar action corroborates it), so it is a price-only factor carried by the cube's level factor S(d) with the 2012-10-01 ADT/Pentair spin (Yahoo 2.011667672500503); shares carry neither. Measured 2026-10-08: close_split x S x Tyco sharesbas equals Sharadar TYC marketcap on every row filed after 2007-10-03.

vendor_series_overrides.evidence: JCI's pre-seam price history is Tyco's (CIK 0000833444, the legal survivor; FTD H89128104/G91442106 prices match Yahoo JCI), but Sharadar's JCI rows before the 2016-09-02 merger are old Johnson Controls, Inc.'s (CIK 0000053669). Sharadar TYC (permaticker 573113, secfilings CIK 0000833444, delisted 2016-09-02) is Tyco's own series: its marketcap equals price x sharesbas on all 83 ARQ rows and its price / JCI close_split is constant within each share-basis segment (decision D2a, 2026-10-07).

reverse_acquisitions.evidence: AMB Property Corp (CIK 0001045609, renamed Prologis, Inc.) was the legal acquirer and surviving registrant of the merger with ProLogis (CIK 0000899881) consummated 2011-06-03 (8-K Item 2.01); ProLogis was the accounting acquirer, so Prologis, Inc.'s post-merger 10-K/10-Q present old ProLogis's pre-merger periods as comparatives. PLD's pre-seam price history is AMB's.

Tyco International plc (CIK 0000833444, renamed Johnson Controls International plc) was the legal acquirer and surviving registrant of the merger with Johnson Controls, Inc. (CIK 0000053669) consummated 2016-09-02 (8-K Items 2.01, 3.03 filed 2016-09-06); the successor's FY2016 10-K (0000833444-16-000216) states that Johnson Controls, Inc. was the accounting acquirer, so its post-merger 10-K/10-Q present old JCI's pre-merger periods as comparatives. JCI's pre-seam price history is Tyco's.
